hunks.baseline: Then I flashed a broad smile at the familiar face that caught my eye first.
hunks.sol: Then I flashed a broad smile at the first familiar face I spotted.

hunks.baseline: So much for the old saying that nobody spits in a smiling face. It was a complete lie.
hunks.sol: So much for the old saying that nobody spits in a smiling face.

hunks.baseline: “Then let me guess. Is it finally time for a family reunion?”
hunks.sol: “Then let me guess. Is it finally time for the brothers to reunite?”

hunks.baseline: “Right. Four characters: brothers reunited.”
hunks.sol: “Right. In four characters: a reunion of brothers.”

hunks.baseline: “Not quite? Too long? How about a chaotic reunion of brothers? One word shorter, but pretty much the same thing.”
hunks.sol: “Not quite? Too long? How about a chaotic reunion of brothers? One character shorter, but pretty much the same thing.”

hunks.baseline: I smiled and patted Jeong Hogun’s armor. Behind him, the killing intent of the Embroidered Uniform Guards standing like iron towers began to rise in waves.
hunks.sol: I smiled and patted Jeong Hogun’s armor. Behind him, killing intent rose like a heat haze from the Embroidered Uniform Guards standing like iron towers.

hunks.baseline: “You look rather exhausted. As if you didn’t get much sleep last night.”
hunks.sol: “You look rather tired. As if you didn’t get much sleep last night.”

hunks.baseline: Anyone with half a brain could tell that Jeong Hogun hadn’t tossed out that remark on a whim.
hunks.sol: Anyone with half a brain could tell Jeong Hogun hadn’t tossed out that remark without a reason.

hunks.baseline: I looked into his calmly lowered eyes and the blade hidden in them, thinking to myself:
hunks.sol: I looked into his calm eyes and the blade hidden in them, thinking to myself:

hunks.baseline: From the very start, he’d given off the strong impression that he knew something.
hunks.sol: From the start, he’d given me the strong impression that he knew something.

hunks.baseline: Knowing that, I furrowed my brow and answered,
hunks.sol: Knowing that, I made a show of furrowing my brow.

hunks.baseline: “You need to feel comfortable to get any sleep. Could you sleep soundly with a bunch of menacing men surrounding you on every side?”
hunks.sol: “You need to feel comfortable to get any sleep. Could you sleep soundly with a bunch of men in black surrounding you on every side?”

hunks.baseline: “No, the more I think about it, the stranger it gets. If you’re guarding him, there are already soldiers everywhere. I don’t see why the Embroidered Uniform Guard needs to be on this kind of high alert. And if you’re surrounding him, that makes even less sense.”
hunks.sol: “No, the more I think about it, the stranger it gets. If you’re guarding him, there are already soldiers everywhere. I don’t see why the Embroidered Uniform Guard needs to keep watch this closely, too. And if you’re surrounding him, that makes no sense either.”

hunks.baseline: And in this essay question where either answer would lead to a dead end, Jeong Hogun chose silence.
hunks.sol: Faced with an essay question that led to a dead end either way, Jeong Hogun chose silence.

hunks.baseline: Getting under the skin of someone who’d run out of things to say was my specialty.
hunks.sol: Getting under the skin of someone who’d run out of things to say was one of my specialties.

hunks.baseline: “Honestly, you were surprised when your commander suddenly killed one of his subordinates yesterday, weren’t you? Is he always that reckless? I won’t tell anyone, so just whisper it to me. My earlobes are sensitive, so whispering’s a little awkward. Just use Sound Transmission once.”
hunks.sol: “Honestly, you were surprised when your commander suddenly killed one of his subordinates yesterday, weren’t you? Is he always that reckless? I won’t tell anyone, so just whisper it to me. My earlobes are sensitive, though, so whispering’s a little awkward. Just use Sound Transmission once.”

hunks.baseline: And Jeong Hogun held out far longer than I’d expected. He finally opened his mouth after I asked whether the Embroidered Uniform Guard’s chow was any good—and then started digging into his family tree.
hunks.sol: Jeong Hogun held out far longer than I’d expected. He finally opened his mouth after I asked whether the Embroidered Uniform Guard’s chow was any good—and started digging into his family tree.

hunks.baseline: “That’s enough… Give it a rest.”
hunks.sol: “Could you… give it a rest now?”

hunks.baseline: I could feel his superhuman patience in the one breath he took between words. I nodded with a touch of respect, then replied,
hunks.sol: I could hear his superhuman patience in that one breath between words. I nodded with a touch of respect.

hunks.baseline: “So you’re still an unmarried bachelor, then?”
hunks.sol: “So you’re still a bachelor, then?”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t get me wrong. I’m not criticizing you for being unmarried at your age. I mean, I’m not your parents. And staying single isn’t so bad—you won’t ruin someone else’s life by accident. So don’t let it get you down. Keep your package—no, your shoulders—up…”
hunks.sol: “Don’t get me wrong. I’m not criticizing you for being unmarried at your age. I mean, I’m not your parents. And staying single isn’t so bad—you won’t ruin someone else’s life. So don’t let it get you down. Keep your pecker—no, your shoulders—up…”

hunks.baseline: With a voice low and heavy, a calloused palm stopped the guard’s golden armor in its tracks. The guard who recognized the hand as belonging to the very superior I’d just insulted shouted in a voice bubbling with rage.
hunks.sol: A calloused palm stopped the guard’s golden armor in its tracks. The voice that followed was low and heavy.

hunks.baseline: “Thousand Captain! How can you let that bastard—”
hunks.sol: The guard recognized the hand as belonging to the very superior I’d just insulted. “Thousand Captain! How can you let that bastard—”

hunks.baseline: One punch, delivered with a heavy yet swift movement—brief, precise, and ruthlessly efficient.
hunks.sol: One punch, heavy but not slow, delivered in a short, efficient movement.

hunks.baseline: Jeong Hogun’s fist caught the Embroidered Uniform Guard squarely on the jaw. The man crumpled without even a groan, and I watched him fall with a quiet sound of admiration.
hunks.sol: Jeong Hogun’s fist caught the Embroidered Uniform Guard squarely on the jaw. The man crumpled without even a groan, and I let out a quiet sound of admiration.

hunks.baseline: For another reason entirely than the impressive way Jeong Hogun had moved.
hunks.sol: Not for Jeong Hogun’s impressive technique, though.

hunks.baseline: It was a side of him I hadn’t seen on the way to the imperial capital or after we’d arrived.
hunks.sol: It was a side of him I hadn’t seen on the way to the Imperial Capital or after we’d arrived.

hunks.baseline: A sign that his composure had slipped—and my guess had been right.
hunks.sol: His composure had slipped. My guess had been right.

hunks.baseline: “From the hour of the Ox to the hour of the Tiger. Three red lanterns were lit.”
hunks.sol: “From the hour of the Ox to Insi. Three red lanterns were lit.”

hunks.baseline: “From what I’ve heard, that was how the East Depot’s secret signals worked. Probably.”
hunks.sol: “From what I’ve heard, the East Depot used secret signals like that. Probably.”

hunks.baseline: From the hour of the Ox to the hour of the Tiger. Exactly when Ma Sanbao had come to see me.
hunks.sol: From the hour of the Ox to Insi. Exactly when Ma Sanbao had come to see me.

hunks.baseline: *And the signal used red lanterns, too.*
hunks.sol: *And red lanterns as a signal, too.*

hunks.baseline: It was lucky that Jeong Hogun wasn’t looking me in the eye while whispering in my ear.
hunks.sol: It was lucky Jeong Hogun wasn’t looking me in the eye while whispering in my ear.

hunks.baseline: Otherwise, he might have noticed the tiniest flicker of a reaction.
hunks.sol: Otherwise, I might have betrayed myself with the tiniest movement.

hunks.baseline: I quietly and instantly steadied my breathing and pulse, so no one could notice, then gave a short laugh.
hunks.sol: I steadied my breathing and pulse quietly, in an instant, without anyone noticing. Then I gave a short laugh.

hunks.baseline: After countless thoughts flashed through my mind like streaks of lightning, I reached a single conclusion.
hunks.sol: Countless thoughts flashed through my mind before I reached a single conclusion.

hunks.baseline: The imperial palace, the East Depot—only people like that could survive in places like these.
hunks.sol: The imperial palace, the East Depot—only people like that could survive in places like those.

hunks.baseline: All those judgments came in an instant—so fast it barely seemed like time had passed.
hunks.sol: I reached all those conclusions in an instant.

hunks.baseline: Jeong Hogun stared at my eyes, which didn’t waver in the slightest. His answer was practically decided already.
hunks.sol: Jeong Hogun stared into my eyes, which didn’t waver in the slightest. His answer was practically decided already.

hunks.baseline: “The night was unusually noisy. A fierce storm and thunder kept roaring without letup.”
hunks.sol: “The night was unusually noisy. A fierce storm, thunder and lightning without letup.”

hunks.baseline: Was the thing in those black eyes a suspicion he still couldn’t let go of?
hunks.sol: Was the look in those black eyes suspicion he still couldn’t let go of?

hunks.baseline: Three people came down the stairs, their footsteps accompanied by a familiar, androgynous voice.
hunks.sol: Three people came down the stairs. The familiar, androgynous voice belonged to one of them.

hunks.baseline: Hong Jin, standing behind Prince Shangshan, who wore a tense expression, gave a wry smile.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin, standing behind the tense-looking prince, gave a wry smile.

hunks.baseline: What?
